IOS系统Windwos系统的剪贴板共享1.目前的<strong>微信输入法还不太完善，很多条件下都无法共享剪贴板</strong>，在这里给出两个方法实现Windows——&gt;IOS系统的剪贴板和IOS——&gt;Windows系统的剪贴板共享操作<strong>Windows——&gt;IOS系统</strong><br>
1.电脑端下载quicker打开网站<font style="color:rgb(65, 131, 196)">https://getquicker.net/Sharedaction?code=fc8b73ff-5176-48ca-c650-08dd8a4658e6</font> 复制动作到剪贴板，然后打开<br>
<img id="aimg_fBj39" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165301808.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165301808.png"><br>
2.手机端在APP store 下载Bark api.day.app/机器码 ，复制机器码，并粘贴到<br>
<img id="aimg_N3BUB" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165611131.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165611131.png"><br>
是否需要加密或是修改图标等操作，请自行查看api<br>
3.打开quicker 找到快捷键，绑定自己熟悉的快捷键，尽量不要使用alt键，会失效<br>
<img id="aimg_sR7j1" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165758274.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165758274.png"><br>
<img id="aimg_F0kAh" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165758274.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205165758274.png"><br>
4.推荐设置好各种参数以后在这里加入这些命令，会更高效<br>
<img id="aimg_pEt7Y" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205170322903.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205170322903.png"><br>
成功后的效果截图，选中需要复制的文字，然后按下快捷键<br>
电脑端：<img id="aimg_UEsEk" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205170350270.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205170350270.png"><br>
ios端：<img id="aimg_DikBL" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/IMG_0341.PNG" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/IMG_0341.PNG"><br>
这里的图标和标题可以自己通过参数修改，这个是我修改以后的效果<br>
<strong>IOS——&gt;Windows系统</strong>这里我有两种情形：<br>
1.手机获取到验证码后需要在电脑上输入。<br>
2.手机主动向电脑发送验证码<strong>电脑端</strong><br>
1.需要支持ssh服务，并且<strong>防火墙开放22端口传入</strong>，新建ps1文件<br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[PowerShell] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: powershell; gutter: true"># =======================================================
# iPhone -&gt; Windows 剪贴板同步 (隐身服务版)
# =======================================================
&amp;#8203;
# 1. 监听路径 (D盘固定路径)
$bufferFile = "D:\clipboard\clipboard_buffer.txt"
&amp;#8203;
# 2. 启动提示 (仅在调试时可见，打包EXE后完全不可见)
if ($Host.Name -eq 'ConsoleHost') {
    Write-Host "&amp;#128123; 隐身服务已启动..." -ForegroundColor DarkGray
}
&amp;#8203;
# 3. 无限循环监听
while ($true) {
    if (Test-Path $bufferFile) {
        try {
         
            Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100
            
      
            $content = Get-Content -Path $bufferFile -Raw -Encoding UTF8 -ErrorAction Stop
            
            if (-not [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($content)) {
                $content = $content.Trim()
               
           
                Set-Clipboard -Value $content
               
              
            }
            
      
            Remove-Item -Path $bufferFile -Force
        }
        catch {
        
        }
    }
&amp;#8203;
    Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500
}</pre></div><br>
通过监听txt 内容变化从而修改剪贴板<strong>手机端</strong>1.通过快捷指令手动发送剪贴板<br>
<img id="aimg_hQEi3" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/IMG_0342.PNG" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/IMG_0342.PNG"><br>
代码命令<br>
<div style="padding:15px 0;"><div style="font-size:12px;">[PowerShell] <em class="viewsource" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">纯文本查看</em> <em class="copycode" style="cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;color:#369 !important;">复制代码</em></div><pre class="brush: powershell; gutter: true">powershell -NoProfile -Command "$null=New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'D:\clipboard'; Set-Content -Path 'D:\clipboard\clipboard_buffer.txt' -Value '剪贴板' -Encoding UTF8"</pre></div><br>
<strong>请注意这里的value要设置为你获取的剪贴板变量</strong><br>
效果：<img id="aimg_qTWTm" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/2026-02-05-17-25-05.gif" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/2026-02-05-17-25-05.gif"><br>
2.手机获取到验证码后同步发送到电脑，首先打开快捷指令-自动化-新建自动化<br>
<img id="aimg_lTy13" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205172719867.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205172719867.png"><img id="aimg_IBC3x" onclick="zoom(this, this.src, 0, 0, 0)" class="zoom" file="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205172753618.png" onmouseover="img_onmouseoverfunc(this)" lazyloadthumb="1" border="0" alt="" src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/bxy0128/TyporaImage/image-20260205172753618.png"><br>
